label: FREE GUIDE
headline: Confused by marketing jargon? Get clear now!
body: This free guide explains 102 internet marketing terms in plain English, from A to Z, so you can understand the lingo.
caption: Navigating the world of online marketing can feel like learning a new language. You're busy creating, selling, or freelancing, and you don't have time to decipher confusing jargon. Our free guide, 'The Internet Marketing Dictionary', simplifies 102 key terms from A to Z, all in plain English. Get your copy today and speak the language of marketing with confidence! 💡
